output_list.reason: The setPromo function is only callable by the contract owner. However, it does not check if the caller is the owner before updating the promoValue. This could allow anyone to set the promoValue, potentially leading to unauthorized changes.

The mintTokens function is only callable by the contract owner. However, it does not check if the caller is the owner before minting tokens. This could allow anyone to mint tokens, potentially leading to unauthorized changes.

The transfer function does not check if the caller has sufficient balance before transferring tokens. This could allow anyone to transfer tokens from any address, potentially leading to unauthorized transfers.

The transferFrom function does not check if the caller has sufficient allowance before transferring tokens. This could allow anyone to transfer tokens on behalf of another address, potentially leading to unauthorized transfers.

The approve function does not check if the caller has sufficient balance before approving tokens. This could allow anyone to approve tokens on behalf of another address, potentially leading to unauthorized approvals.
